workspace: empty scratch dir per round, still empty afterwards
commands: node temp/m47-capture.mjs $TMPDIR/m47-live (round 1: pause first, then children, resume, cancel)
node temp/m47-capture2.mjs $TMPDIR/m47-live2 (round 2: children first, then pause, resume, cancel)
node temp/m47-capture3.mjs $TMPDIR/m47-live3 (round 3: reactive skip probe, then cancel)
each script spawns: muse serve --disable-sandbox --contributor-mode on --trust-workspace (cwd: the empty workspace)

each script speaks MSP over stdio: initialize, session/start (model muse-spark-1.3-contributor, approvalMode allowAll), turn/start asking for a 4-parallel-essay workflow, then the control commands above
isolation: HOME and XDG_DATA_HOME pointed at the scratch dir (sessions and traces stay out of the owner store); XDG_CONFIG_HOME pointed at the real config home so the CLI reads its own sign-in; no credential value read, printed or stored by the lane; the owner settings file carries no run block (checked boolean-only), so the Workflow tool was offered by default
countSource: the CLI trace in the scratch home (model.attempt.lifecycle phase=admission lines naming the session), read after each host exited; each round ran in a fresh scratch dir holding exactly one session
notes: workflow/childControl targets the in-flight attempt: skip and retry on started/usage children are accepted; skip on a scheduled child is refused -32030 commandRejected invalid_target (rounds 1-3), as is any childControl while paused on a scheduled child (round 1)
an accepted skip ends the attempt terminal/cancelled with no new attempt (round 3, rev15-16)
an accepted retry ends attempt N terminal/cancelled and schedules attempt N+1 under the same childId (round 2, rev16-18, rev25)

an accepted pause keeps the run inProgress with no paused status on the item; every in-flight attempt drains to terminal/cancelled while scheduled children stay scheduled (round 2, rev13-27); the launching turn had already completed, so the pause is the only cause
an accepted resume drives a turn (ack turnId) and re-emits the item under it; round 2 reconciled the run to completed with a latest_failure recovery note

an accepted cancel drains every attempt to terminal/cancelled, then item/completed status=cancelled with a reconciled message (final_summary null); round 3 retains the children, round 1 re-emitted the item childless under the resume turn first
a cancel past settlement is refused -32030 commandRejected missing_run (round 2)
no child carried a phase field in any revision (M47 left-out item stays open)
